hero.headline: Your business, still able to play tomorrow.
hero.subhead: A viability-governed operator for finite work, human authority, and replayable learning.
hero.product_pitch: Cambium is the living operator above your finite AI agents. It wakes on evidence, protects viability, advances mission, gates consequence, and records why every meaningful move happened.

problem.headline: Your agents finish tasks. Your company still needs continuity.
problem.body: Genesis can mint the brand. Hands can build. Will can go to market. Each run should end. What is missing is the layer between them: the one that remembers the cause, watches the limits, and decides which bounded game matters next.

features.name: Wake
features.headline: Dormant between events. Never done.
features.body: Cambium wakes when real evidence arrives, takes one bounded operating step, persists the result, and returns to rest. Quiet is a valid state—not a failed activity metric.

features.name: Viability
features.headline: Protect the ability to continue.
features.body: Name the bounds that matter: solvency, mission coherence, legal and ethical limits, founder capacity. When a margin narrows, the next move points inward.

features.name: Cascade
features.headline: Advance the cause, not the dashboard.
features.body: Vision stays near-invariant. Missions renew. Goals become finite games. Revenue and growth remain regulated fuel—not the thing the system worships.

features.name: Founder gate
features.headline: Consequence stays human.
features.body: Reversible, authorized work can proceed. Paid, irreversible, identity-changing, or externally representative actions stop at an explicit founder gate.

features.name: Replay
features.headline: Every meaningful move leaves a reason.
features.body: Typed world-state and event receipts let you reconstruct what happened, what evidence was used, who had authority, and what remains held.

how_it_works.title: Name the living bounds
how_it_works.body: Define the vision, current mission, goals, and the margins the venture cannot cross.

how_it_works.title: Let evidence wake the operator
how_it_works.body: A real event enters world-state. Cambium checks relevance, freshness, provenance, and current margin.

how_it_works.title: Play one finite game
how_it_works.body: Cambium proposes the bounded specialist run that best advances the mission while preserving viability.

how_it_works.title: Gate, persist, and learn
how_it_works.body: Consequential moves ask for the right authority. The result lands as a replayable receipt before the system rests again.

faq.question: Is Cambium another team of AI employees?
faq.answer: No. Specialist agents remain finite tools. Cambium is the operator that chooses when one should act, checks the venture's bounds, and carries learning across runs.

faq.question: Does it replace the founder?
faq.answer: No. It reduces continuous supervision while preserving the founder's authority over paid, irreversible, identity-changing, and externally representative moves.

faq.question: Does Cambium maximize revenue?
faq.answer: No. Revenue is fuel and solvency is a hard bound. The source objective is advancing the vision through renewable missions without losing the ability to continue.

faq.question: What is a viability kernel here?
faq.answer: The exact high-dimensional kernel is not computed. Cambium uses explicit hard bounds and observable proxy margins, and treats narrowing margin as a reason to choose a safer next move.

faq.question: What does replayable mean?
faq.answer: A consequential move carries the triggering event, evidence, current state, authority, decision, output, and receipt needed to reconstruct why it happened.

faq.question: Is the product live?
faq.answer: This brand package includes doctrine, local design outputs, and illustrative visuals. Live product capability must be stated only from current production receipts.

final_cta.headline: Start with the bound that keeps you awake.
final_cta.body: Name what would force your venture out of the game. Then map the finite work that can widen that margin without hiding consequence.
